svg.desc: Аналоговый индикатор стрелочный для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: UseExternalBounds
rt:param.comment: Использовать пользовательские уставки из параметров привязки (только при NoBounds = False)

rt:param.name: SubRangesNumber
rt:param.comment: Количество подделений в каждом диапазоне, минимум - 1, максимум - 10

rt:param.name: OutsideMarks
rt:param.comment: Разместить значения во внешней части циферблата

rt:var.name: AckSupport
rt:var.comment: Фиктивная переменная, означающая, что данный объект поддерживает самоквитирование по функции AckMe()

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub AckMe() If Allow_Confirm && Blink_on_NACK && flag_confirm && (In_Alarm > 0) && MyAlarm Then If pv.NotAcknowledged Then pv.AcknowledgeAlarm(0) End If AckThisBinPV(B_HIHI) AckThisBinPV(B_HI) AckThisBinPV(B_H) AckThisBinPV(B_L) AckThisBinPV(B_LO) AckThisBinPV(B_LOLO) ' AckThisBinPV(B_IMITATION) In_Alarm = False End If End Sub
Sub AckThisBinPV(ByVal curPV As PlsPVBin) If (curPV != Nothing) Then If curPV.NotAcknowledged Then curPV.AcknowledgeAlarm(0) End If End If End Sub

Sub ValCalc() dim c as UInt If pv == Nothing Then Exit Sub End If
Value = pv.Value
Dim B_Viol As UInt 'нарушения границ B_Viol = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_NONE
BGround.fill = "#949494" //ValColor = 0x555555
If NoBounds Then c = Color_NB(pv) If (c != Color_ANA_GOOD) Then BGround.fill = c End If ElseIf UseExternalBounds Then Dim LR As Double Dim HR As Double
LR = pv.RangeLow HR = pv.RangeHigh
If ((pv.SuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) > 0 ) Then BGround.fill = Color_Remont ElseIf (pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then BGround.fill = Color_Inval
ElseIf (pv.OriginalQualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE) Then BGround.fill = Color_Imitation
ElseIf (pv.OriginalQualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_RANGEEXCEEDED) Then BGround.fill = Color_Inval End If
If ((val_HAB != -9999) && (val_HAB > LR) && (val_HAB < HR) && (Value > val_HAB)) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_A B_Viol = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI ElseIf ((val_LAB != -9999) && (val_LAB > LR) && (val_LAB < HR) && (Value < val_LAB)) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_LO_A B_Viol = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_LO ElseIf ((val_HWB != -9999) && (val_HWB > LR) && (val_HWB < HR) && (Value > val_HWB)) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_P B_Viol = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI ElseIf ((val_LWB != -9999) && (val_LWB > LR) && (val_LWB < HR) && (Value < val_LWB)) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_LO_P B_Viol = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_LO ElseIf ((val_HTB != -9999) && (val_HTB > LR) && (val_HTB < HR) && (Value > val_HTB)) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_T B_Viol = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI ElseIf ((val_LTB != -9999) && (val_LTB > LR) && (val_LTB < HR) && (Value < val_LTB)) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_LO_T B_Viol = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_LO End If ElseIf FName Then c = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv) if (c == Color_Remont) || (c == Color_Inval) || (c == Color_Imitation) Then BGround.fill = c Else ValColor = c End If /* If (c != Color_ANA_GOOD) && (c != Color_Remont) && (c != Color_Inval) && (c != Color_Imitation) Then ValColor = c End If */ Else c = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_XH(FKKS, Suffix) if (c == Color_Remont) || (c == Color_Inval) || (c == Color_Imitation) Then BGround.fill = c Else ValColor = c End If //If (c != Color_ANA_GOOD) && (c != Color_Remont) && (c != Color_Inval) && (c != Color_Imitation) Then /* If (c != Color_Remont) && (c != Color_Inval) && (c != Color_Imitation) Then ValColor = c End If */ End If
If (ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD) && !pv.NotAcknowledged && (In_Alarm == 0) Then ValColor = 0x555555 End If
Show_Pointer()
End Sub

Sub DetectAlarms() If PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv.PVId, False) Then In_Alarm = 0 Exit Sub End If If MyAlarm && pv.NotAcknowledged Then If pv.OriginalQualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE Then In_Alarm = 0 //имитация значения ElseIf pv.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Else In_Alarm = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация End If Else In_Alarm = 0 End If If FName Then Exit Sub End If If B_HIHI != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_HIHI.NotAcknowledged Then If B_HIHI.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_HI != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_HI.NotAcknowledged Then If B_HI.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_H != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_H.NotAcknowledged Then If B_H.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_L != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_L.NotAcknowledged Then If B_L.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_LO != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_LO.NotAcknowledged Then If B_LO.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_LOLO != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_LOLO.NotAcknowledged Then If B_LOLO.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If End Sub
/*Sub DetectAlarms() If PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv.PVId, False) Then In_Alarm = 0 Exit Sub End If If MyAlarm && pv.NotAcknowledged Then If pv.OriginalQualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE Then In_Alarm = 0 //имитация значения ElseIf pv.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Else In_Alarm = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация End If Else In_Alarm = 0 End If If FName Then Exit Sub End If If B_HIHI != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_HIHI.NotAcknowledged Then If B_HIHI.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_HI != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_HI.NotAcknowledged Then If B_HI.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_H != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_H.NotAcknowledged Then If B_H.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_L != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_L.NotAcknowledged Then If B_L.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_LO != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_LO.NotAcknowledged Then If B_LO.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_LOLO != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_LOLO.NotAcknowledged Then If B_LOLO.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If End Sub*/

Sub Shkala() dim i as uint dim j as uint dim xx1 as float dim yy1 as float dim xx2 as float dim yy2 as float dim alfa1 as float dim s_shkala as string dim s_podshkala as string dim tick as RtSvgObj s_shkala = "" for i = 1 to RangesNumber s_podshkala = "" alfa1 = (pi / 4) + alfa * (i - 1) xx1 = -(rr * Sin (alfa1)) xx2 = -(RR * Sin (alfa1)) yy1 = (rr * Cos (alfa1)) yy2 = (RR * Cos (alfa1))
s_shkala = s_shkala + " M" + CStr(xx1) + " " + CStr(yy1) + " L" + CStr(xx2) + " " + CStr(yy2) if i < RangesNumber Then for j = 1 to SubRangesNumber xx1 = -((rr + l / 2.0) * Sin (alfa1 + beta * j)) xx2 = -(RR * Sin (alfa1 + beta * j)) yy1 = ((rr + l / 2.0) * Cos (alfa1 + beta * j)) yy2 = (RR * Cos (alfa1 + beta * j)) s_podshkala = s_podshkala + " M" + CStr(xx1) + " " + CStr(yy1) + " L" + CStr(xx2) + " " + CStr(yy2) next j tick = Podshkaly.Child(i - 1) tick.d = s_podshkala tick.visibility = "visible" End If next i Shkala.visibility = "visible" Shkala.d = s_shkala End Sub

Sub Marks()
dim i as uint dim alfa1 as float dim Znach as double dim Diap as double dim r_m as float dim a as double dim label as RtSvgObj
NumDijits = pv.RoundDigits Diap = (val_HR - val_LR)/(RangesNumber - 1) If OutsideMarks Then r_m = RR + 10 'радиус окружности, на которой располагаются значения Else If Len(CStr(val_HR / ScaleValue)) <= 3 Then r_m = rr - 6 Else r_m = rr - 10 End If End If
For i = 1 to RangesNumber label = Marks.Child(i - 1) alfa1 = (pi / 4) + alfa * (i - 1) label.x = -(r_m * Sin (alfa1)) label.y = (r_m * Cos (alfa1)) a = val_LR + Diap * (i - 1) a = a / ScaleValue Znach = Round(a, NumDijits)
If ShowNums || (i = 1) || (i = RangesNumber) Then
If OutsideMarks Then dim sdvig as float sdvig = label.font_size - 2 If (alfa1 < (pi / 2) - (pi / 18)) Then label.text_anchor = "end" label.rt_text_vertanchor = "start" label.dy = sdvig ElseIf (alfa1 >= (pi / 2) - (pi / 18)) && (alfa1 <= (pi / 2) + (pi / 18)) Then label.text_anchor = "end" ElseIf (alfa1 > (pi / 2) + (pi / 18)) && (alfa1 < pi) Then label.text_anchor = "end" label.rt_text_vertanchor = "start" ElseIf (alfa1 == pi) Then label.text_anchor = "middle" label.rt_text_vertanchor = "start" ElseIf (alfa1 > pi) && (alfa1 < (3 * pi / 2) - (pi / 18)) Then label.text_anchor = "start" label.rt_text_vertanchor = "start" ElseIf (alfa1 >= (3 * pi / 2) - (pi / 18)) && (alfa1 <= (3 * pi / 2) + (pi / 18)) Then label.text_anchor = "start" Else label.text_anchor = "start" label.rt_text_vertanchor = "start" label.dy = sdvig End If End If label.text = RoundAscii (Znach, NumDijits, true) label.visibility = "visible" End If next i End Sub

Sub Sectors() dim alfa1 as float dim i as int dim val_LR_num as int
val_LR_num = 1
If UseExternalBounds Then Dim LR As Double Dim HR As Double
LR = pv.RangeLow HR = pv.RangeHigh
If ((val_LTB != -9999) && (val_LTB > LR) && (val_LTB < HR)) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 1, val_LR, val_LTB - val_LR, Color_ANA_LO_T) End If
If ((val_HTB != -9999) && (val_HTB > LR) && (val_HTB < HR)) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 2, val_HTB - val_LR, val_HR - val_LR, Color_ANA_HI_T)
End If
If ((val_LWB != -9999) && (val_LWB > LR) && (val_LWB < HR)) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 3, val_LR, val_LWB - val_LR, Color_ANA_LO_P)
End If
If ((val_HWB != -9999) && (val_HWB > LR) && (val_HWB < HR)) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 4, val_HWB - val_LR, val_HR - val_LR, Color_ANA_HI_P) End If
If ((val_LAB != -9999) && (val_LAB > LR) && (val_LAB < HR)) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 5, val_LR, val_LAB - val_LR, Color_ANA_LO_A) End If
If ((val_HAB != -9999) && (val_HAB > LR) && (val_HAB < HR)) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 6, val_HAB - val_LR, val_HR - val_LR, Color_ANA_HI_A) End If
Else
If pv.UseBoundsHigh(0) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 2, pv.BoundsHigh(0) - val_LR, val_HR - val_LR, Color_ANA_HI_T) End If
If pv.UseBoundsHigh(1) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 4, pv.BoundsHigh(1) - val_LR, val_HR - val_LR, Color_ANA_HI_P) End If
If pv.UseBoundsHigh(2) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 6, pv.BoundsHigh(2) - val_LR, val_HR - val_LR, Color_ANA_HI_A) End If
If pv.UseBoundsLow(0) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 1, val_LR, pv.BoundsLow(0) - val_LR, Color_ANA_LO_T) End If
If pv.UseBoundsLow(1) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 3, val_LR, pv.BoundsLow(1) - val_LR, Color_ANA_LO_P) End If
If pv.UseBoundsLow(2) Then Show_Sector(val_LR_num + 5, val_LR, pv.BoundsLow(2) - val_LR, Color_ANA_LO_A) End If End If
End Sub

Sub Show_Pointer() Dim alfa1 as double Dim xx as float Dim yy as float
If (Value >= val_LR) && (Value <= val_HR) Then alfa1 = pi / 4 + ((3 * pi / 2) * (Value - val_LR) / (val_HR - val_LR)) ElseIf Value <= val_LR Then alfa1 = pi / 4 - 0.06 Else alfa1 = 7 * pi / 4 + 0.06 End If xx = -(RR * Sin (alfa1)) yy = (RR * Cos (alfa1)) Pointer.x2 = xx Pointer.y2 = yy End Sub

Sub Show_Sector(ByVal Child_num as int, ByVal val_LR_Pos as double, ByVal val_HR_Pos as double, ByVal col_sector as uint)
dim xx1 as float dim xx2 as float dim yy1 as float dim yy2 as float dim s as string dim s_inv as string
dim beta_val_LR as double dim beta_val_HR as double
If val_LR_Pos < 0 Then val_LR_Pos = 0 End If If (val_LR_Pos <= val_HR_Pos) Then beta_val_LR = pi / 4 + (3 * pi / 2) * val_LR_Pos / (val_HR - val_LR) beta_val_HR = pi / 4 + (3 * pi / 2) * val_HR_Pos / (val_HR - val_LR)
xx1 = -(RR * Sin (beta_val_HR)) xx2 = -(RR * Sin (beta_val_LR)) yy1 = (RR * Cos (beta_val_HR)) yy2 = (RR * Cos (beta_val_LR))
If ((beta_val_HR - beta_val_LR) > pi) Then s = " M0 0 L" + CStr(xx1) + " " + CStr(yy1) + " A" + CStr(RR) + " " + CStr(RR) + " 0 1 0 " + CStr(xx2) + " " + CStr(yy2) + " Z" else s = " M0 0 L" + CStr(xx1) + " " + CStr(yy1) + " A" + CStr(RR) + " " + CStr(RR) + " 0 0 0 " + CStr(xx2) + " " + CStr(yy2) + " Z" End If
_This.Child(Child_num).d = s _This.Child(Child_num).visibility = "visible" _This.Child(Child_num).fill = col_sector End If
End Sub

Sub CheckUsrGr() If UseExternalBounds || NoBounds Then MyAlarm = False ElseIf Alarms_ForUser Then //если надо распределять сигнализаци по пользователям MyAlarm = PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(pv.PVId, True) Else MyAlarm = True End If
/* If FName Then DetectAlarms() Exit Sub End If */ If !(FName || NoBounds) Then If B_HIHI != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_HIHI.PVId, False) End If End If If B_HI != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_HI.PVId, False) End If End If If B_H != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_H.PVId, False) End If End If If B_L != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_L.PVId, False) End If End If If B_LO != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_LO.PVId, False) End If End If If B_LOLO != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_LOLO.PVId, False) End If End If End If DetectAlarms() End Sub

Sub Show_AddInfo() dim s as string
If ShowScale Then s = "x" + CStr(ScaleValue) else s = EU End If
Add_Info.visibility = "visible" Add_Info.T_String = s End Sub
rt:model.rt:event:
If RangesNumber > 10 Then 'проверяем на корректность ввода RangesNumber = 10 ElseIf RangesNumber < 2 Then RangesNumber = 2 End If If SubRangesNumber > 10 Then SubRangesNumber = 10 ElseIf SubRangesNumber < 1 Then SubRangesNumber = 1 End If If Koeff_Color_Mix < 0.3 Then Koeff_Color_Mix = 0.3 ElseIf Koeff_Color_Mix >1 Then Koeff_Color_Mix = 1 End If
pi = 355.0 / 113.0 RR = BGround.r - 5.0 RangesNumber = RangesNumber + 1 ' чир должно быть на одну больше, чем диапазонов SubRangesNumber = SubRangesNumber - 1 ' чир должно быть на одну меньше, чем поддиапазонов rr = RR - l beta = (3 * pi / (2 * (RangesNumber - 1))) / (SubRangesNumber + 1) 'угол между подделениями alfa = (3 * pi / 2) / (RangesNumber - 1) 'угoл между делениями
If FName Then Set pv = ANA(FKKS) Else Set pv = ANA(FKKS + "_" + Suffix)
If !NoBounds Then Set B_IMITATION = GetImitationPV(pv.PVId) If (PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 1) == "Н.Д.") Then Set B_HIHI = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_HI_A) Set B_HI = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_HI_P) Set B_H = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_HI_T) Set B_L = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_LO_T) Set B_LO = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_LO_P) Set B_LOLO = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_LO_A) Else Set B_HIHI = BIN(FKKS + "_" + PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 6)) Set B_HI = BIN(FKKS + "_" + PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 5)) Set B_H = BIN(FKKS + "_" + PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 4)) Set B_L = BIN(FKKS + "_" + PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 3)) Set B_LO = BIN(FKKS + "_" + PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 2)) Set B_LOLO = BIN(FKKS + "_" + PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 1)) End If End If
End If
If pv == Nothing Then
HasError = True BGround.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK EU = "" Pointer.visibility = "hidden" Shkala () If (val_LR <> -9999) && (val_HR <> -9999) Then Marks() End If Exit Sub End If
If val_LR == -9999 Then val_LR = pv.RangeLow End If If val_HR == -9999 Then val_HR = pv.RangeHigh End If If ScaleValue <= 1 Then ScaleValue = 1 ShowScale = false Else ShowScale = true End If If !ShowScale && ShowEU Then EU = pv.DimString Else EU = "" End If If ShowEU || ShowScale Then Show_AddInfo() End If Shkala () Marks() If !NoBounds Then Sectors() End If //MyAlarm = Blink_on_NACK && Alarms_ForUser && !HasError CheckUsrGr()
BGround.r = _This.height Hat.r = BGround.r - 5.0 - l/2.0 Hat1.r = BGround.r - 5.0 InGr.r = BGround.r + 2.5 InGr.stroke_width = 2 SelFrame.r = BGround.r

circle.rt:event: If pv == nothing Then NoLink(FKKS) Else If NoBounds || UseExternalBounds Then Call_Win ("ws_ANA_NB", pv.PVId + "|-1") ElseIf FName Then Call_Win ("ws_ANA_FN", FKKS + "|-1") Else Call_Win ("ws_ANA", FKKS + "|" + Suffix + "|-1") End If End If

If pv == nothing Then NoLink(FKKS) Else If NoBounds || UseExternalBounds Then LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_NB " + pv.PVId + "|-1") ElseIf FName Then LoadPopUpMenu(FKKS + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + FKKS + "|-1") Else LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA " + FKKS+"|" + Suffix + "|-1") End If End If
